tools.name: grade_key
tools.description: What each grade means for a given year, the percentage band it covered, and how many legislators received it. The bands change from year to year.

tools.name: legislator_record
tools.description: One legislator's Liberty Rating in every session they served, found by name, slug, personId or employeeNo. Joins the two employee numbers a member holds if they moved between the House and the Senate.

tools.name: legislator_votes
tools.description: The roll calls NHLA scored in one session, how a legislator voted on each, and whether that matched NHLA's position. Optionally filtered to one bill.

tools.name: legislators_for_town
tools.description: Every state representative and senator for a New Hampshire town, with their Liberty Rating. Use this for "who represents me".
